decisions.reason: It survived the first review period with dedicated website visibility, suggesting results at least near aspiration levels, and a large established firm is likely to retain such a complementary niche product.

Its continued stand-alone presentation after launch indicates acceptable early performance and strategic fit, so boundedly rational management would more likely exploit it than redeploy the resources.
Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, its performance is more uncertain, but having outlasted the initial cull the firm likely keeps it while slack still allows learning.
Although it appears to be a secondary offering, it remained after related products were already removed, implying it cleared a minimum aspiration threshold and is worth retaining for now.
